newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe old man admits sex with dog.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe old man admits sex with dog.

text.p: A Zimbabwean villager aged over 80 years has pleaded guilty to having regular sex with his bitch dog.

The man -- Chiundura Kubwarasekwa who estimates his age at between 80 and 90 -- was fined Z$200 ($19) last weekend by a magistrate court in Zimbabwe's midlands town of Chivhu, court officials told reporters on Tuesday.
He was reported to the police by fellow villagers, they said.
